Quick answer

What is HALU? HALU™ is Neural Horizons AI's cross-department intelligence agent. It reads findings that Zonar OS™ has verified and writes plain-language briefings for department heads, with every statement traced to a source record. Your team approves every action that matters.

Is it agentic AI with a human in the loop? Yes. HALU monitors, drafts, flags and escalates. People approve the actions that matter, and every action is logged.

What HALU™ does

Not a chatbot.
Not a dashboard.

HALU is the explaining layer. Zonar OS does the checking. HALU turns each verified run into something a department head can read in a minute and act on.

📝

A briefing for every verified run

Counts by severity, the findings that matter most, and the evidence behind each one, in plain language.

💰

A view for each department

Delivered-not-invoiced, undelivered orders, price differences and invoices with no order, each with its source rows.

💬

Ask HALU

Ask a question and get an answer from the verified data only. If the answer is not there, HALU says so.

🚦

An optional readiness gate

Nothing is delivered until the data, the definitions and a boundary signed by your business owner are in place.

🔔

Automatic delivery

New verified runs are picked up and briefed without anyone chasing. Your team approves every action.

🧾

A decision log

Every delivery, and every time a briefing was held back, is recorded with the reason.

How it's built

Human-in-the-loop agentic AI
you can audit.

Zonar OS and HALU combine a deterministic reconciliation engine with a grounded large language model (LLM) layer. The engine decides what is true. The language layer explains it. People approve what matters.

🧑‍💼

Human in the loop

HALU drafts, flags and escalates. Your people approve every action that matters. Pre-approved playbook actions run only inside limits a human set, and every one is logged.

⚙️

A deterministic core

Reconciliation is rule-based and repeatable. The same files give the same findings. No language model decides what is true.

🔗

Grounded answers (RAG)

Ask HALU uses retrieval-augmented generation over verified findings. It retrieves the evidence first, then answers from it, with the source rows. No evidence, no answer.

🧠

An LLM that explains, not invents

The LLM writes the plain-language briefing. It cannot introduce a fact the evidence does not carry, and every statement keeps its source reference.

🛡️

Guardrails against hallucination

Verified-only inputs, source-row citations, refusal when evidence is missing, an optional readiness gate and a decision log of every delivery and every hold.

🔐

Governance and security

Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, role-based access control, one client per credential, tenant isolation, a full audit trail, and backup and recovery.

FAQ

Common questions about HALU™.

What is the difference between HALU™ and Zonar OS™?+
Zonar OS™ is the verification layer. It matches your operational files against each other and flags every discrepancy with evidence. HALU™ is the agent that reads what Zonar OS™ has verified and briefs your people. Zonar OS™ checks. HALU™ explains.
Can HALU™ run without Zonar OS™?+
Yes, in a lighter form. HALU™ Lite starts on your existing CRM, analytics and communication tools. For briefings built on verified findings, with every statement traced to a source row, HALU™ works from Zonar OS™, which is why we deploy them together.
How does HALU™ actually monitor my departments?+
HALU™ connects to your existing data sources, such as CRM, email, project management and analytics, and runs a continuous monitoring loop across departments. It does not wait to be asked. It surfaces issues, generates action items and routes them to the right person.
Is a human in the loop?+
Yes. HALU™ drafts, flags and escalates. Your team approves every action that matters. Pre-approved playbook actions run only inside limits a human set, escalation logic keeps people in control, and every action is logged and explainable.
Does HALU™ use an LLM or RAG?+
HALU™ pairs a deterministic reconciliation engine with a large language model (LLM) layer that explains verified findings in plain language. Answers use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): HALU™ retrieves the verified evidence first, then answers from it, citing the source rows. The language model cannot introduce a fact the evidence does not carry.
Can HALU™ hallucinate?+
We design against it. Inputs are verified findings only, every statement keeps a source reference, HALU™ declines to answer when evidence is missing, and an optional readiness gate holds delivery until the data, definitions and a signed boundary are in place. Every delivery and every hold is logged.
Is HALU™ available as a white-label product?+
Yes, on the Enterprise tier. You can license HALU™ under your own brand and sell it to your clients. Contact support@neuralhorizonsai.com for white-label pricing.
Is it available now?+
Yes. We scope each rollout with you and handle setup, training and onboarding. The Reconciliation Audit module in Zonar OS™ is currently a pilot programme.
What does it cost?+
Pricing is scoped to your business and includes onboarding. Contact us and we will talk it through. Questions? support@neuralhorizonsai.com
